summary: PowerBank Corp filed a Form 6-K on July 1, 2026, announcing the closing of a registered direct offering of 7,000,000 common shares at $0.60 per share for gross proceeds of $4.2 million to two new institutional investors. A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners acted as sole placement agent. The offering was conducted under an effective shelf registration statement on Form F-10, which became effective on May 9, 2025. Net proceeds will fund IPP project portfolio delivery, working capital, and general corporate purposes. This is a routine capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
